method: Stratified search then local refinement. Paired token seeds, all 18 scenarios, worst-case score weighted 3x plus mean. Exact production quotes; finite token conservation; verified native C2 bank.

bank.method: Public C2 rules and native auto battles; session/action time is explicitly modeled, without browser presentation. Paired account/calendar seeds reused across scenarios. Final-fortnight yields are extrapolated after the measured cohort window; this is not 52-week combat telemetry.
